**Prior Degrees:** Bachelor of Engineer in Mechanical Engineer

I am Preetam Panja, graduated with a Bachelor of Engineering Degree in Mechanical Engineering from University of Mumbai, India in 2017. I am from India. I joined CCWJ in September 2021. Presently associated with CCWJ as a Research Assistant.  My hobbies are cooking, watching TV series, playing badminton, riding a bicycle,  and some newly developed hobby is Ice-skating. 

#### Project

Right after my undergraduate, I started working in the welding industry as a sales and application engineer where I was researching developing new welding procedures specifications (WPS) to help customers increase their productivity by minimizing the overall cost and maintaining quality. My biggest achievement working in industries was when I successfully developed a Titanium welding procedure for pressure vessel equipment manufacturers by adhering to welding codes (ASME section IX) to increase their productivity by 60% and saving the overall welding cost by 47% which resulted in increasing my companies net revenue by 28% and tapped business from unexplored markets.
